decisions.evidence: I won't be dealing is grammatical; I'll be won't be contains incompatible stacked auxiliaries.
The parallel Hornet version independently uses one body at a time, matching Vindicta's kill-focused characterization.
All component revisions contain substantive errors in today/a day, LashBack spelling, charity syntax, or can't/can/kind of suck; none is fully correct.
Filename identifies the purple Walker objective; water is an ASR substitution.
It's a simple matter of translocation is a complete grammatical sentence; revision 0 substitutes To.
Given a target is grammatical and coherent for Haze; in a target is not.
Enemy-Lash filename requires Lash as direct address; neither Talash nor Carlash is correct.
Repository lore repeatedly says Ivy took out Mendoza; took on conflicts with those parallel lines.
者 specifically denotes another person inheriting the sword; もの is an ambiguous phonetic spelling in this context.
He versus I changes the subject, and revision 0 includes an audible uh filler absent from revision 1.
The component mixes want to versus wanna and gathered versus gathering; these are audible semantic differences.
Enemy-Orion context targets one named opponent, making singular man coherent; men changes the number.
Revision 1 adds the audible subject It; both are grammatical colloquial victory statements.
Can-heal-Viscous context requires Viscous, I can heal you; neither This guess nor This guest is correct.
Game term and filename require Stim Pack's almost ready; Stimpack lacks the space and Stem pack changes the word.
Under-attack context and r2 outside the component establish They're taking our tier 1; both component revisions change the meaning.
Parallel lines establish Warp Stone's on cooldown; Warfstones and unspaced Warpstone are not correct existing readings.
Lash is the authoritative character spelling and matches the filename.
Filename identifies Zealot headed to orange; neither Zella nor Zilla preserves that era-specific target.
Releasing singularity is the grammatical ability activation; Release in singularity is malformed.
Both How I've been exposed and How I been exposed are malformed in this context; no evidence makes either fully correct.
Metal Skin prevents damage, so Those aren't gonna hurt me is coherent; the opposite reading conflicts with ability context.
Filename targets Geist under the garage; neither Gas nor Glass preserves the character name.
Ghost is an era path for Geist, but neither Gas nor Glass preserves that character name.
Filename targets Murphy under the garage; neither Move nor Movie is correct.
Misery is the standard word and forms a coherent sentence; misera is not an English word.
Grey Talon is the authoritative configured character spelling.

Careful-Hornet context and r2 outside the component give Careful, Vindicta; both component revisions are unrelated.

Infernus is the authoritative configured character spelling.
